title: app pages: the predicate scope gains the bound row and the organisation's plan, so `visibleWhen` can follow tier and count (新建环境 on paid tiers, the 🔒 line on Free, the 生产 tag with a second environment) (ruling B on cloud#2774)
body:
Unblocked: #12971 closed `completed` when PR #13043 merged as `8aa8e3e1e5` (objectui's pin is now objectstack `main` `f4755a68a797`); re-derived with no new blocker (unlock comment below).

Filed by the director seat (summon #43 continuation 4, `session_01QJC7i981TSs9L1CGJK59Ax`) on the maintainer's ruling Q2 B on objectstack-ai/cloud#2774 (batch #362 item 5, 「其他同意」; the ruling record is that card's `Ruled:` line) under the standing 口径 「平台相关的功能，应该尽量先改平台」. ⛔ Not a claim. Filing gate ①: a measured gap in renderer capability with a named consumer.

## What is measured (objectui `origin/main` `1e6d83bc4895`)
- `packages/app-shell/src/providers/ExpressionProvider.tsx:190`: an `app` page's predicate scope is `current_user` / `user` / `ctx` / `os` / `features` — no bound row, no plan, no count. So the ruled environments page (cloud#2839 Q1 = D; cloud#2942 Q1 A / Q2 A) cannot express 「新建环境 only on paid tiers」, 「🔒 开发环境 · 团队版起 only on Free」, 「the 生产 tag only when a second environment exists」, or a single-vs-many switch.

## Scope
1. The `app`-page predicate scope exposes the page's bound rows (by their `dataSource` id) and the organisation's entitlement (plan) under declared roots, read from data the page already loads; an undeclared root still refuses at parse time.
2. The scope is declared in the spec's predicate documentation if a new root name is needed (the lane states `Clause-②` accordingly; prefer existing roots).
3. Pins: a page block hidden on Free and shown on Team; a tag shown only when a bound list has ≥ 2 rows.

## Done when
- The tests above are green; cloud#2916 / #2774's environments page can express its three conditions.

Related: objectstack-ai/cloud#2774, #2916, #2942 (Q1 / Q2 A), #2839.
